name: Investigate
description: Structured investigation process for diagnosing issues, understanding system behavior, or answering questions that require research. Gathers evidence, analyzes findings, and produces a clear report.

steps.title: Gather context and define scope
steps.description: Recall any relevant context from memory about ${topic}. Check project context if available. Define the specific questions we need to answer and what evidence to look for.
steps.accept_criteria: Investigation scope is defined with clear questions to answer. All available context has been gathered.

steps.title: Investigate primary sources
steps.description: Investigate ${topic} by examining primary sources: logs, configuration files, code, infrastructure state, or documentation. Use the tools available (exec, read, web-fetch) to gather concrete evidence. Record exact findings — commands run, outputs observed, error messages, timestamps.
steps.accept_criteria: Primary evidence has been gathered from at least 2 sources. All findings are documented with exact details (not summaries).

steps.title: Analyze findings and identify root cause
steps.description: Analyze the evidence gathered about ${topic}. Identify the root cause or answer the investigation questions. If the initial investigation was insufficient, gather additional evidence. Cross-reference findings for consistency.
steps.accept_criteria: Root cause or answer is identified with supporting evidence. Analysis explains the 'why' not just the 'what'.

steps.title: Document findings and recommendations
steps.description: Produce a clear investigation report about ${topic}. Include: (1) Summary of findings, (2) Root cause analysis, (3) Evidence chain, (4) Recommended actions or next steps. Update project context with relevant discoveries.
steps.accept_criteria: Investigation report is complete with actionable findings. Project context updated if applicable.
